benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: IDFC FIRST WOW! Black is a secured card with up to **16.7% value-back on travel spends**. This card primarily caters to frequent travellers with accelerated rewards on travel spends, complimentary lounge access & zero forex markup fee. The card offers **50 bonus points** for every Rs. 150 spent on hotels & 30 bonus points for every Rs. 150 spent on flight bookings through IDFC FIRST’s mobile app. Cardholders can redeem the accumulated reward points at a value of **1 RP = Rs. 0.50** against travel bookings and save significantly on their travel spends. Besides travel, this credit card also offers accelerated reward points on other online & offline spends, along with a base reward rate on often-excluded categories, such as insurance and utility bills. Another thing that makes this card stand out is the joining benefits. At a joining fee of Rs. 750, this card offers **joining benefits worth more than Rs. 5,000** through complimentary memberships, bonus cashback, and discounts on travel bookings.

faqs.q: What is IDFC FIRST WOW! Black Credit Card?
faqs.a: IDFC FIRST WOW! Black is a secured credit card primarily focused on travel & lifestyle, offering value on everyday purchases. Additionally, this card offers benefits such as a UPI-enabled RuPay virtual card, accelerated reward points on online/offline spends, making it a decent choice for consumers who want to start their credit journey with a secured card.

faqs.q: Is there any annual fee for IDFC FIRST WOW! Black Credit Card?
faqs.a: Yes, IDFC FIRST WOW! Black Credit Card comes with a Rs. 750 annual fee + Taxes, which can be waived off on spending Rs. 1.5 Lakh in a year, making this card a cost-effective choice for the regular consumers.

faqs.q: Can I convert large purchases into EMIs on this card?
faqs.a: Yes, transactions can be converted into EMIs at the bank’s applicable interest rate. The card also offers 5% cashback up to Rs. 1,000 on the first EMI transaction made within 30 days.

faqs.q: Who is eligible to apply for IDFC FIRST WOW! Black Credit Card?
faqs.a: Indian residents planning to start their credit journey can apply for this credit card. You are required to open an FD account with a minimum of Rs. 20,000 to avail this credit card.

faqs.q: How can I apply for IDFC FIRST WOW! Black Credit Card?
faqs.a: The application can be completed online through the IDFC FIRST Bank website by opening an FD account, or you can also visit the nearest branch.

faqs.question: What is the minimum fixed deposit required for the IDFC FIRST WOW! Black Credit Card?
faqs.answer: You need to open a fixed deposit of at least ₹20,000. The card offers a credit limit of up to 100% of the fixed deposit amount.

faqs.question: Does the IDFC FIRST WOW! Black Credit Card charge a forex markup fee?
faqs.answer: No. The card offers 0% forex markup on all international transactions.

faqs.question: How much reward can I earn on hotel and flight bookings?
faqs.answer: You can earn an effective reward rate of up to 9.67% on hotel bookings and 6.33% on flight bookings made through the FIRST Rewards Gallery.

faqs.question: Does the IDFC FIRST WOW! Black Credit Card offer airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: Yes. The card offers four complimentary domestic airport lounge visits per year, limited to one visit per calendar quarter. You must spend ₹20,000 in the current month to unlock access for the following month.

faqs.question: What is the value of IDFC FIRST WOW! Black Reward Points?
faqs.answer: Reward Points are worth ₹0.50 each for hotel and flight bookings through the FIRST Rewards Gallery and ₹0.25 each for all other redemption options.
